description: Opens a pull request when a chart that Argo CD deploys has a newer version.
Only the Argo CD Application files are read: Dependabot already covers pip, GitHub Actions and Docker.
Nothing merges by itself. Longhorn is not here: deploy.sh installs it and its version is held on purpose.

The snapshot controller, deployed from a tag of its git repository

packageRules.description: Kyverno and its policies chart are released together
